newsitem.title: USA: RCM finishes Programming Alternatives buy.
newsitem.headline: RCM finishes Programming Alternatives buy.

text.p: RCM Technologies Inc said on Friday it completed its acquisition of Programming Alternatives of Minnesota Inc.

It said Programming Alternatives, a specialty provider of information technology consultants -- especially those with high demand client-server skills -- is expected to have annualized reveunes of approximately $11 million, a substantial increase over 1995..
RCM, through its wholly owned subsidiaries, provides contract and temporary staffing services to U.S. businesses.
